faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DCPU Salem Case Worker recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the DCPU Salem Case Worker recruitment is 25 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address by this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Case Worker post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed the 12th grade from a recognized board and possess good communication skills to be eligible for the Case Worker position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Case Worker position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Case Worker post is 42 years as of 22 August 2026. There is no minimum age specified.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Case Worker role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Case Worker post will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 18,000/-.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the DCPU Salem Case Worker vacancy?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it correctly, attach necessary documents, and send it to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the DCPU Salem Case Worker recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Case Worker position primarily involves Document Verification. Candidates are advised to be prepared for this stage.

faq.question: Q8. What type of job is this recruitment for?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity. The selected candidates will be appointed on a contractual basis for the Case Worker post.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of DCPU Salem, which is https://salem.nic.in/. Links are also provided in the 'Important Links' section of this article.

faq.question: Q10. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the post of Case Worker in the District Child Protection Unit Salem recruitment.
